ModMetaData.name: Mechanoids Can Hunt
ModMetaData.author: Jacob / Hermes
ModMetaData.description:
Allows eligible mechanoids to perform hunting work.
By default, any mechanoid capable of ranged attacks qualifies for hunting work. Explicit melee combat mechanoids (such as Scythers) can be permitted via configuration, while non-combat or inappropriate mechanoids (such as Cleansweepers) are excluded.
Features: - Ranged combat mechanoids are eligible by default when they have a viable ranged attack. - Scythers and Tunnelers are explicitly eligible; melee attack behavior is provided by Hunters Use Melee! (Continued). - Utility and non-combat mechanoids are excluded by default; ranged-armed combat mechs are not filtered by weapon type. - Loads after Mlie.HuntersUseMelee; this mod does not replace its hunting job or melee attack logic.
